metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: Since they loved Shrek and Puss in Boots, they will adore this heartwarming and action-packed DreamWorks adventure about a boy and his friendly dragon.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: Perfect for fans of high-energy adventures like Spider-Man and Sonic, featuring a hilarious and loving family of superheroes.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful, gentle Pixar film about friendship and discovery under the sea, matching the warm vibes of Finding Nemo and Ponyo.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Kids who enjoyed The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic the Hedgehog will love this clever, colorful adventure inside various video games.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A fantastic, action-packed Disney adventure featuring a lovable robot companion that will capture the hearts of kids who liked Wall-E and Sonic.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A wildly funny, chaotic family adventure from the creators of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, packed with visual humor.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An incredibly sweet and wholesome family comedy that delivers the same pure, heartwarming magic found in Matilda and Totoro.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Frozen II and Tangled, they must experience the magical origin story of Elsa, Anna, and Olaf the snowman.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud superhero comedy from DreamWorks that matches the witty humor of Despicable Me and Shrek.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A colorful, emotional, and highly adventurous Pixar film that will appeal greatly to kids who loved Inside Out and Coco.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Fans of Ghibli films like Kiki's Delivery Service and Totoro will fall in love with this beautiful story of tiny people living secretly among us.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilarious animal adventure from the creators of Despicable Me and Migration.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A hilarious, animal-filled DreamWorks comedy that matches the wild and colorful fun of Rio and Ice Age.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest comedies of all time, sharing the witty, fast-paced humor of Shrek and Puss in Boots.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny sci-fi adventure about family and friendship, perfect for fans of Turning Red.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly creative and hilarious adventure movie filled with food-themed chaos that kids will find absolutely delightful.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A thrilling prehistoric family road-trip comedy that matches the humor and heart of Ice Age.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic, family-friendly Pixar adventure about standing up for what is right, great for fans of Toy Story.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A high-tech, heartwarming holiday comedy from Aardman, the same studio behind Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: An incredibly sweet, wholesome, and faithful adaptation of the classic comic strip, perfect for a cozy family movie night.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Since they have watched the first two, they must see Po's journey continue as he teaches a whole village of pandas the art of kung fu.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: The direct sequel to Despicable Me, bringing back Gru, the girls, and even more hilarious Minion antics.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A beautiful and magical journey across China to help a young Yeti get home, matching the visual wonder of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical, modern-fantasy brotherhood adventure from Pixar that fans of Inside Out and Monsters, Inc. will love.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: This hilarious prequel shows how Mike and Sulley met, making it the perfect follow-up for fans of Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From the creators of Chicken Run, this dialogue-free claymation comedy is packed with clever slapstick humor that will make the whole family laugh.

metas.name: Over the Hedge
metas.description: A highly entertaining DreamWorks animal heist comedy that will appeal to fans of The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Night at the Museum
metas.description: A thrilling live-action adventure where museum exhibits come to life, offering the same wonder and comedy as Matilda and Sonic.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical Studio Ghibli fantasy adventure perfect for kids who love magical feline stories like Puss in Boots.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A timeless, heartwarming live-action family classic about a polite little pig with a big heart, perfect for animal lovers.

metas.name: Mary Poppins
metas.description: A delightful musical fantasy that offers the same comforting family magic as Annie and Matilda.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A wonderful, lighthearted blend of live-action and animation that lovingly pokes fun at classic Disney fairytales like Tangled.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A charming and action-packed Disney adventure about a Hollywood dog who thinks he actually has super powers, perfect for fans of Sonic.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Having watched Simba's Pride and Mufasa, this legendary Disney masterpiece is an absolute must-watch for the family.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A beloved, high-octane Pixar family comedy filled with memorable characters, perfect for kids who love Toy Story.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: A thrilling and hilarious sequel that delivers more superhero family fun, keeping up with the action of the Spider-Verse movies.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A hilarious spin-off focusing entirely on the silly yellow sidekicks that kids loved in Despicable Me.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: An incredibly sweet and funny musical comedy about a class pet lizard helping kids with their elementary school problems.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A beautifully animated, clever adventure about overcoming fears, featuring the same charm and intelligence as Inside Out.
